title: Relative Mayer-Vietoris sequence for the higher direct images along a morphism of schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the relative Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence for the higher direct images along f : X -> Y when X is the union of two open subschemes U and V (statement lines 7222-7239). The proof is a short-exactness argument on complexes: after resolving F injectively on X_etale, one has to see that the complex-level sequence 0 -> f_* I^bullet -> a_* I^bullet|_U direct sum b_* I^bullet|_V -> c_* I^bullet|_{U cap V} -> 0 is short exact, which the author does by evaluating on sections over each object W of Y_etale, where the sequence becomes the Mayer-Vietoris sequence of the fibre products W x_Y X, W x_Y U, W x_Y V, W x_Y (U cap V) (proof lines 7252-7262). The remaining step is to recognise the restricted complexes as injective resolutions (proof lines 7263-7265), which is what converts cohomology sheaves into higher direct images of the restrictions. The claim is H2: one exactness check on sections plus one standard identification.
